points.name: system.notifications.group.item_register
points.interpretation: Both paths register callback 0x0c5259ad with filter 7 and a notification-record pointer as user data; the callback starts detail navigation.

points.name: system.notifications.group.clear_register
points.interpretation: The clear-all row registers callback 0x0c5259bd with filter 7. The callback invokes the grouped-notification clear function.

points.name: system.notifications.group.app_name
points.interpretation: The list-update callback sets record field +12 as the app name on the corresponding row label.

points.name: system.notifications.group.title
points.interpretation: The list-update callback sets record field +16 as the title on the corresponding row label.

points.name: system.notifications.group.content
points.interpretation: The list-update callback sets record field +20 as content on the corresponding row label.

points.name: system.notifications.group.time
points.interpretation: The list-update callback formats the record timestamp into a local buffer and passes it to the text setter.

points.name: system.notifications.group.clear_caption
points.interpretation: The list-update callback obtains clear_all.notify and sets it on the clear-all button label.

evidence: The aggregation page stores its root before building the list and clears it on destroy. The list builder registers a record-backed row callback and a separate clear-all callback. The list update routine sets the app name, title, body and formatted time from a notification record and refreshes the clear-all caption.
scope: Only recorded row registration and list-update text calls while the aggregation root is active. Initial row rendering and other notification views may use other paths.
limitations: Notification data is sensitive. Arbitrary record pointers can crash the callback, and changing or skipping clear-all registration may alter the ability to clear notifications. Shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
